dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, customer relations. This is Karen speaking.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˌæftərˈnuːn, ˈkʌstəmər rɪˈleɪʃənz. ðɪs ɪz ˈkærən ˈspiːkɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. I'm calling in response to your email from yesterday.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˌæftərˈnuːn. aɪm ˈkɔːlɪŋ ɪn rɪˈspɑːns tə jʊr ˈiːmeɪl frəm ˈjɛstərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. What is it regarding?
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈwʌt ɪz ɪt rɪˈɡɑːrdɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's regarding my complaint about the hotel in Krabi. You asked for my booking reference and the hotel invoice.
dialogue.reading: ɪts rɪˈɡɑːrdɪŋ maɪ kəmˈpleɪnt əˈbaʊt ðə hoʊˈtɛl ɪn ˈkrɑːbi. juː ˈæskt fər maɪ ˈbʊkɪŋ ˌrɛfərəns ənd ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈɪnvɔɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I sent them this morning, as requested. Did you receive them?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈsɛnt ðɛm ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, əz rɪˈkwɛstɪd. dɪd juː rɪˈsiːv ðɛm?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let me check… Yes, I can see them. But I'm afraid the invoice isn't very clear.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈtʃɛk… ˈjɛs, aɪ kən ˈsiː ðɛm. bʌt aɪm əˈfreɪd ði ˈɪnvɔɪs ˈɪzənt ˈvɛri ˈklɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry. I took a photo of it with my phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈsɑːri. aɪ ˈtʊk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ɪt wɪð maɪ ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Could you scan it and send it again, please?
dialogue.reading: kʊd juː ˈskæn ɪt ənd ˈsɛnd ɪt əˈɡɛn, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll send a clearer copy this afternoon.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪl ˈsɛnd ə ˈklɪrər ˈkɑːpi ðɪs ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you. With regard to your refund, Mr. Turner will call you this week.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. wɪð rɪˈɡɑːrd tə jʊr ˈriːfʌnd, ˈmɪstər ˈtɜːrnər wɪl ˈkɔːl juː ðɪs ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. I look forward to hearing from him.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. aɪ ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈhɪrɪŋ frəm hɪm.
